summary: Synchrony Card Funding, LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $1 billion asset-backed notes issuance by Synchrony Card Issuance Trust, backed by credit card receivables. The Class A(2026-2) notes carry a 4.69% coupon, price to public at 99.97334%, and are scheduled to close on August 12, 2026. This is a routine securitization takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. There are no change-of-control, strategic, or capital-return elements; it is standard structured-finance activity. Risk-arb or special-situation monitoring is not applicable; focus remains on credit performance and structural triggers.
